Rows failing (3) or (4) are excluded and tallied below, not listed.
ordering: CATALOG ONLY. This list retires the no-auto duplicate rows; the already-present :auto twin at each address is the surviving canonical row. No reslug is needed and nothing is minted.

VERIFICATION IS PER-ID, READ-ONLY, ALL FOUR CRITERIA REQUIRED. (1) source is one of the defective tags; (2) id ends :no-auto...; (3) a TWIN exists at the same id with :no-auto -> :auto, matching sport/year/setKey/cardNumber/parallel/num-N, source NOT defective, player matching; (4) zero resident sold_comps sales (checked by hobbyiqCardId = id and cardId = id). 1009 of 9481 verified candidates passed all four and are listed. 8240 failed (3) -- reason breakdown: {"no twin row at :auto id":8240}. 232 failed (4) and are reported in census.salesResidentDetail, not listed.
